<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Gunner''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">インペリアル・ガンナー（砲手）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">宇宙船に乗客として搭乗しているなら宇宙船の兵器の武器運命数に１を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Imperial-Gunner-PSA-84363904.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ウォーカーは2人組で操作する。1名はAT-ATを操縦する訓練を受けており、もう1名は砲手として働く。インペリアル・ガンナーは自分たちを帝国最高の砲手と自称している。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial Gunner.

'''Card text:'''
If aboard a starship as a passenger, add 1 to that starship’s weapon destiny.

'''Lore:'''
Walker operators work in pairs. One is trained to pilot the AT-AT, and the other works as a gunner. Imperial gunners call themselves the Empire’s finest gunners.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says they call themselves the Empire’s finest gunners.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Gunner]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
